title: Neon Ball Slope
seo_title: Neon Ball Slope — Play Free Neon Slope Game Online
meta_desc: Play Neon Ball Slope free online. Roll a glowing neon ball down an endless 3D slope, dodge hazards and test your reflexes in this fast slope game.
desc: Neon Ball Slope is pure slope-game energy: a glowing ball, an endless 3D descent and speed that never stops climbing. Steer across the slope, dodge hazards and survive the neon rush.
howto: Use the arrow keys to move horizontally.
On mobile, press the left or right side of the screen.
Dodge the hazards scattered down the slope.
Stay on the track as the angle shifts.
Survive as long as the slope allows.
tips: Keep inputs small — the ball carries momentum.
Center the ball before big slope changes.
Scan ahead a full second, not just the next hazard.
